settings.text: Cushion covers are a quick, easy way to elevate your home decor. With eye-catching styles and colours to choose from, they can be matched to your other soft furnishings, such as sofas and curtains, or used to contrast your existing decorating scheme.

settings.heading: Cushion covers that transform your space

settings.text:
Cushion covers are more than just practical, they’re a simple way to add personality and style to any room. Whether you’re looking to introduce a splash of colour, a bold pattern, or just some extra comfort, cushion covers can make all the difference. Add them to your sofa, bed, or reading nook to create a cosy, inviting atmosphere.

And the best part? You can easily switch them out to match your mood, the season, or special occasions. A quick cushion cover change is like a mini makeover for your home.

How to wash cushion covers

Proper care keeps your cushion covers looking fresh and lasting longer. Here’s how to clean them, depending on the material:

  • Wool Covers (like our patchwork designs): Treat them like a wool carpet.
  • Vacuum regularly using an upholstery attachment to remove dust, lint, and pet hair.
  • Spot clean with cold water and a white cloth for minor spills or marks.
  • For tough stains, we recommend contacting a professional cleaner.

We offer a selection of 50×50 cm wool cushion covers, including handknotted patchwork styles. Pair them with an oriental rug for a truly cohesive and elegant interior look.
